## Steps

1. Harvest 200 resources from Visions of Vetrovia Zones (Svarni Expanse, Karuupa Jungle, Mahngavi Wastes, Forlorn Gist)
1. Return to Rakira.

## Rewards

- At least 4p 30g 76s 84c
- [[Bukatan Umber Mane Plushie]]
- [[Vetrovia Amalgamation]]
